key_insight: PredMapNet introduces explicit future and historical reasoning to produce temporally consistent, stable online HD vectorized maps — replacing random query initialization and implicit temporal modeling with structured temporal propagation.
problem_solved: Reduces temporal inconsistencies and instabilities in online HD map construction caused by random query initialization and weak/implicit temporal modeling, enabling a consistent global map over time.
method: Explicit temporal modeling: fuse historical context and predicted future information to stabilize map element representations across frames.
Deterministic query initialization and propagation: initialize and propagate vector queries in a structured way to maintain identity and continuity of map primitives.
End-to-end vectorized output: train a single framework to produce and update HD map primitives online (polylines, lane boundaries, traffic elements) for immediate downstream use.
impact: Provides a more reliable, real-time HD mapping component for autonomous driving and motion planning stacks, improving downstream safety and planner stability. Makes research and production pipelines less sensitive to frame-to-frame fluctuations.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: input sensor frames → historical & future reasoning modules → deterministic query propagation → vectorized map output (clearly labeled blocks).
Before vs. After map consistency panel: side-by-side sequence showing temporal jitter with baseline vs. stable outputs from PredMapNet.
Query propagation animation / schematic: visualization of how queries are initialized and tracked across frames to preserve map primitive identities.
Metric chart: temporal consistency and stability metrics (e.g., IoU over time, identity switches) comparing PredMapNet and prior methods.
paper_title: PredMapNet: Future and Historical Reasoning for Consistent Online HD Vectorized Map Construction
paper_authors: Bo Lang, Nirav Savaliya, Zhihao Zheng, Jinglun Feng, Zheng-Hang Yeh
